name: Narutaki Koyori
source:
Position of the mark: On her left thigh
Curse: [spoiler]Forbidden to open a door that has never been personally passed before[/spoiler]
Gift: [spoiler]Ability to accurately reproduce body actions[/spoiler]

The youngest among the cursed people and the one who proposed to use their talents in helping those who are in need. She is always on her roller blades no matter where she goes traversing terrains skillfully thanks to her gift. That gift is pretty much useful in bed as well.
